name: Reverse the Red Accelerator Award
summary: Small awards for a 12-month project to speed up recovery of a single threatened species, open to those who have submitted a Reverse the Red Species Pledge.

eligibility.rule: Has submitted a Species Pledge for an endangered, critically endangered, extinct-in-wild or data-deficient species
A 12-month project focused on recovering a single species
Submits no more than one proposal per organisation
Has not received this award for the same species in the past two years

status.quote: all candidates must submit a pre-application by the deadline of April 3, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.

deadline.quote: all candidates must submit a pre-application by the deadline of April 3, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.

access.quote: Applications are accepted only through the official submission form.

window.quote: all candidates must submit a pre-application by the deadline of April 3, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.

amount.quote: Up to USD $15,000 to implement a 12-month project

applicant_types.quote: This competitive opportunity is open to organisations and individuals who have submitted a Reverse the Red Species Pledge

effort.quote: To be eligible, all candidates must submit a pre-application by the deadline of April 3, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.
Applicants whose pre-applications are successful will be invited to submit a full application.

eligibility.quote: This competitive opportunity is open to organisations and individuals who have submitted a Reverse the Red Species Pledge for an endangered, critically endangered, extinct in the wild, or data deficient animal, plant, or fungus.
This award supports a 12-month project focused on the recovery of a single species.
You may submit only one proposal per organisation.
previous Accelerator Award recipients may not apply again for the same species until two years after their award.
